title: run-snapshot
description: Generated from the annexes of specs/100-specstride by contracts/tools/generate.py. The annex stands where the two differ.

profile.description: Name of the profile in force, or null

keys.description: For every resolved configuration key: `value`, `source` (rank of §X.2), `class` (`pinned` or `tunable`), and for a learned value the id of the decision

sourceHashes.description: For each of the files `spec`, `plan`, `tasks`: logical path, content hash, and for `tasks` also the hash that ignores checkboxes

acceptedChanges.description: Every intended change accepted on `resume`: time, file, old hash, new hash
